analysis.reason: 직전 판단(2026-10-12)에서 매수 진입 후 3거래일 연속 상승 추세 진행 중. RSI는 중립 구간 회복, MACD 히스토그램은 약화 중이나 음수 구간에서 유지되며 추세 붕괴 신호는 미발생. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 1.78배로 움직임에 힘이 실림. 52주 고가 대비 4.6% 하락한 $742.96에서 스윙 저항선 $744.00 돌파 시 추가 상승 기대.
analysis.reasonEn: Following the previous buy entry (2026-10-12), the uptrend has continued for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has recovered to the neutral zone, and while the MACD histogram is weakening, it remains in negative territory without signaling a trend collapse. Volume ratio of 1.78x the 5-day average indicates strong momentum. A break above the swing resistance of $744.00 from the current $742.96 (4.6% below 52-week high) could fuel further upside.

analysis.narrativeEn:

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (56.8→62.3): neutral zone recovery confirmed, pre-overbought stage.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.1077→-4.8213): weakness persists, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $722.94): trading near the mid-band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($731.00): support confirmed based on 5-day low.
· Swing resistance ($744.00): potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): recovery signal confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.78x): increased confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (uptrend): buy entry condition met on breaking swing resistance.
